about: Every vulnerability, bug and breach found on data.promptugal.news, ours included (Dinis Cruz, 18 November 2026, about 15:15 UTC). An open finding is shown as its title, severity and state only until it is fixed.

findings.title: Links built from fetched URLs kept any scheme (javascript: possible)
findings.found_by: AppSec post-review of 1bf3ad4..55b6db3..HEAD (data.b.security@PrompTugal.dinis, Sonnet, checked by data.b@)
findings.detail: Event URLs from the agendas and evidence URLs from Perplexity answers reached [label](url) links on /events/ and the source pages; a javascript: URL would have run script in the reader's browser on a click. Quotes were already escaped. No such URL was seen in the data.
findings.fix: inline() keeps only http(s), site-relative, # and mailto links; anything else becomes #

findings.title: robots.txt "Disallow: /" was read as allowed by the events collector
findings.found_by: AppSec post-review of 1bf3ad4..55b6db3..HEAD (data.b.security@PrompTugal.dinis, Sonnet, checked by data.b@)
findings.detail: A site banning all crawling would still have been read. None of the hosts read had such a rule.
findings.fix: the root disallow now blocks the host

findings.title: An event without an http(s) URL could break the site build
findings.found_by: AppSec post-review of 1bf3ad4..55b6db3..HEAD (data.b.security@PrompTugal.dinis, Sonnet, checked by data.b@)
findings.fix: such events are dropped and counted

findings.title: URL filters missing in discovery, claims, the social collector and the charts
findings.found_by: AppSec post-review of 1bf3ad4..55b6db3..HEAD (data.b.security@PrompTugal.dinis, Sonnet, checked by data.b@)
findings.fix: non-http(s) URLs dropped or replaced by #; malformed model items skipped

findings.title: The observability credentials folder was created after the credentials file
findings.found_by: AppSec post-review of 1bf3ad4..55b6db3..HEAD (data.b.security@PrompTugal.dinis, Sonnet, checked by data.b@)
findings.fix: the folder is made 0700 first (the file itself was 0600; one-user container)

findings.title: adsb.lol raw answers, which name private aircraft by hex id and position, went to a public-read vault
findings.detail: The copies written on 17 November are still in vault sd1fblzs; removing them is for Dinis.
findings.fix: the collector no longer passes the raw answer to the vault

findings.title: Perplexity answer text is served as evidence and could carry injected instructions for a model that reads it later
findings.found_by: AppSec post-review of 1bf3ad4..55b6db3..HEAD (data.b.security@PrompTugal.dinis, Sonnet, checked by data.b@)
findings.fix: none: kept as evidence, marked untrusted in the threat model; no injection text found on 18 November

findings.title: CI actions pinned by tag, not by commit
findings.found_by: AppSec post-review of 1bf3ad4..55b6db3..HEAD (data.b.security@PrompTugal.dinis, Sonnet, checked by data.b@)
